announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l3 — Manager follow-ups
announcements.summary: Adds literature review handoff, reimbursement status tracking, and safer Manager startup recovery.
announcements.content:
This local release extends the Manager-side workflow and hardens startup recovery.
1. Literature review: pass selected papers to a dedicated AI reading task with strict per-paper JSON output and explicit evidence limits.
2. Reimbursement: create and update items with draft, submitted, or reimbursed status and an optional status date.
3. Recovery: bound the Codex runtime status probe during parallel startup and recognize a daemon-owned Manager control service.
4. Compatibility: preserve the existing extension identity, private-state boundaries, and Manager Gateway session behavior.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l3 — Manager 后续更新
zh.summary: 新增论文科研阅读整理、报销状态跟踪和更安全的 Manager 启动恢复。
zh.content:
本地版本扩展 Manager 侧工作流并加固启动恢复。
1. 论文阅读：把选中的论文交给独立 AI 阅读任务，按论文 ID 严格输出 JSON，并明确证据边界。
2. 报销状态：创建和更新事项时支持草稿、已提交和已到账状态及状态日期。
3. 恢复逻辑：并行启动期间对 Codex runtime 状态探测设置边界，并识别由 daemon 持有的 Manager control 服务。
4. 兼容性：保留既有扩展 ID、私有状态边界和 Manager Gateway session 行为。
